prompt: Use supplied Sable Regent portrait/gameplay images as exact identity/style reference. Create a transparent RGBA 1536×1024 sprite sheet with eight distinct complete full-body right-facing Sable ball-steal poses in a 4×2 row-major grid. Keep same warm-brown adult human woman, recognizable face, black gathered hair/red headband, Blackthorn black/crimson/white uniform, wristbands and shoes. Preserve human anatomy and silhouette. One Sable per cell. No basketball or other player; the ball is separate at runtime and there is no opponent in the sheet. Action: 0 defensive ready; 1 lower and reach toward an unseen loose dribble; 2 lunge forward, right hand sweeps low toward the floor; 3 steal anchor pose with hand at ball height, fingers reaching to intercept (grab frame3); 4 pull invisible ball toward her torso; 5 turn and rise; 6 recover control in balanced stance; 7 reset. Clearly athletic defensive lunge, all eight poses distinct and complete, hair/body/shoes inside every cell. Crisp limited-palette 1990s arcade pixel art with strong outline, not painterly, glossy or 3D. Transparent alpha-zero background, no checkerboard/matte/ground/shadow/text. Return only sheet.

ballTrack.notes: The separate ball enters Sable’s low forward reach at grab frame3, then follows her gather.

review.reviewNotes: The accepted-looking initial sheet had only seven isolated bodies: top-row steal poses 2 and 3 touch as one connected component. The eight-pose packer rejected it. Preserved unchanged as rejected source history; do not pack.

rejectionReason: Initial generated sheet failed source isolation: poses 2 and 3 touch, leaving seven distinct full-body components.
